title: Germany: 2 arrested, suspected of plotting synagogue attack
summary: Federal prosecutors say they have ordered the arrest of two members of a pro-Iranian group on suspicion of planning an attack on a synagogue. They were detained in the cities of Heidelberg and…

image.caption: Prosecutors reported two arrests on ThursdayImage: Julian Stratenschulte/dpa/picture alliance

blocks.text: Germany's federal prosecutor's office on Thursday said it had ordered the arret of two Iraqi citizens in Germany who are believed to be members of a pro-Iranian terrorist group.
It identified the men as Mostafa Al-R. and Ameer J., and said that they were arrested in Heidelberg in Baden Württemberg in the southwest, and in Cologne, several hours' drive to the north.
Officers from Germany's federal criminal police force carried out the arrests.
What accusations do the men face?
Prosecutors said the two men were "strongly suspected" of membership in a domestic terrorist organization.
This is a developing story, more to follow...
